== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[Blackflame]] [[madra]] is a volatile and destructive energy characterized by its black and red coloration. It possesses an aggressive, furious, and predatory nature, often described as behaving like a ravenous dragon that seeks to advance and destroy everything in its path. This power is highly effective at piercing defenses, shattering barriers, and incinerating materials without leaving molten residue. When used in combat or through specific techniques like the [[Burning Cloak]] or [[The Dragon Descends|Dragon Descends]], it can manifest as liquid flame, claws, or explosive bursts of heat and destruction. Despite its potency, the [[madra]] is inherently corrosive to the user. It consumes the body and spirit from the inside out, causing physical damage to muscles and bones while eroding the soul and mental stability. Prolonged or uncontrolled use can lead to madness, reduced lifespans, and the transformation of users into hollowed shells. To prevent permanent injuries or blockages in their spiritual channels, practitioners must frequently cleanse themselves using [[pure madra]]. The [[Blackflame family]], once an empire, largely perished due to this self-destructive property.}}

== Blackflame ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|[[Blackflame]] [[madra]] is a specialized type of [[madra]] that can billow out as black fire and ravage both the mind and body. This substance is difficult to Forge, yet it can be moved by feel without the need for convoluted patterns. When [[Lindon]] utilizes the [[Fierce Fire Robe]] technique, he is shrouded in a thin haze of black and red fire. He has demonstrated its versatility by using it to ignite tinder, spraying it from his own body, or releasing a pulse to blow apart a soldier. The [[madra]] can also be sprayed from the mouth of [[Orthos]], though it has caused damage to the creature's spirit over many centuries and can harm a user's [[madra channels]]. When focused, the energy behaves like a hungry beast.}}
